payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including macro-average F1-score increases and specific percentage improvements in relation classification.

claims.text: The model outperforms previous state-of-the-art systems on the benchmark corpus of PDTB.
The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7 percent for implicit relation classification.
Compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model, the model improved the macro-average F1-score by 2.2 percent.
The full model achieved a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for predicting implicit discourse relations.
